source_note: Primary sources are official Orange County Notices of Commencement and other public records. News articles are secondary references only.

permits.title: Polynesian Resort – Island Tower (Faden Builders / Walt Disney Imagineering)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 18, 2026, by Walt Disney Imagineering for Faden Builders Inc. to provide “general construction” at 4601 Floridian Way, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830 (Island Tower at Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows). Permit expires one year from filing. WDI filing (rather than FAM or BVCC) typically indicates guest-facing or creative work rather than routine maintenance. Disney has not announced any specific project. Official Orange County document available. Corroborated by WDWNT and WDWMAGIC reporting.
permits.location: Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows – Island Tower (4601 Floridian Way)
permits.source_name: WDWNT (with official OC document link); corroborated by WDWMAGIC

permits.title: Magic Kingdom – Enchanted Tiki Room (Buena Vista Construction)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 16, 2026, for Buena Vista Construction Company to “provide labor, material and/or electrical for construction” at 4873C Caribbean Way (Walt Disney’s Enchanted Tiki Room, Adventureland). BVCC (in-house) permit rather than WDI; no end date specified so defaults to standard one-year expiration. Indicates general construction/maintenance work rather than show or creative changes. Attraction not currently listed for refurbishment closure. Corroborated by WDWMAGIC reporting and Orange County NOC listings.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – Adventureland (4873C Caribbean Way / Enchanted Tiki Room)
permits.source_name: WDWMAGIC; corroborated by WDWMAGIC forum NOC listing for 9/16/26 (4873C Caribbean Wy)

permits.title: Animal Kingdom – DINOSAUR / Indiana Jones & The Myth of the Jade Serpent (Buena Vista Construction)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed the afternoon of September 11, 2026, for Buena Vista Construction Company to “provide labor, material and/or electrical for construction” at 501 Restaurantosaurus Road (former DINOSAUR attraction, now the site of the upcoming Indiana Jones & The Myth of the Jade Serpent ride in Tropical Americas). Filed by Walt Disney World Resort (not specifically Imagineering), indicating general construction work. Standard scope language; follows earlier construction and theming permit extensions in July. Facade installation of Mayan temple elements is already underway.
permits.location: Disney’s Animal Kingdom – DinoLand / Tropical Americas (501 Restaurantosaurus Rd)
permits.source_name: WDWNT (with official OC document link); corroborated by WDWMAGIC forum NOC listing

permits.title: Polynesian Resort – Tangaroa Terrace (New Horizon Construction)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 10, 2026, for “general conditions” at 1540 Seven Seas Dr (Tangaroa Terrace) with contractor New Horizon Construction Services. Expiration December 31, 2027. Companion filing to the September 8 KHS&S NOC for the same location. New Horizon has previously worked on Coronado Springs and Beach Club refurbishments. Tangaroa Terrace currently functions as a Cast Member break area; longer-than-usual expiration may indicate more extensive improvements. Corroborated by WDWNT reporting.
permits.location: Disney’s Polynesian Village Resort – Tangaroa Terrace (1540 Seven Seas Dr)

permits.title: Polynesian Resort – Tangaroa Terrace (KHS&S)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 8, 2026, for Facility Asset Management (FAM) with contractor Keenan Hopkins Schmidt & Stowell (KHS&S) for “general conditions” at 1540 Seven Seas Dr (Tangaroa Terrace). Expiration set for December 31, 2027 (longer than standard one-year), suggesting potentially more substantial work than routine maintenance. Tangaroa Terrace is a standalone building outside the Great Ceremonial House; previously a buffet restaurant and Neverland Club, currently used as a Cast Member break area. No confirmation of return to guest use. Corroborated by WDWMAGIC and WDWNT reporting.
permits.location: Disney’s Polynesian Village Resort – Tangaroa Terrace (1540 Seven Seas Dr)
